description: The Windows fixes disposed the SqlCatalog sqlite engine in the Redshift and BigQuery test helpers because an open handle locks the file on Windows. The same undisposed pattern remains at tests/unit/utils/test_iceberg_layout.py:85 and in tests/unit/utils/format_converters/test_iceberg_converter.py. They did not fail in the last Windows run (run 39467654899), so this is preventive. Work: dispose in a finally (or a shared fixture), keep the tests unchanged otherwise, and check no other test builds a SqlCatalog without disposal. Guardrail: no skips.
